stations.title: Idris
stations.say: Will the counts be here tomorrow?

stations.title: Store in memory
stations.text: Keeps every count while the program runs.

captions: Idris asks whether the counts will still be there the next morning.
The store keeps them in memory only, so a restart leaves it empty.
You add every change to the end of a log, and replay it when the store opens.
The next morning, card holds its last count and poster stays deleted.
Nothing is ever written over, and the store finds what it had.
